title: Naked Marriage
synopsis: Naked marriages are becoming more and more popular in China. With the risk of disappointing you, this lesson teaches you all about what this “naked marriage” is.

fullText.simplified:
“裸婚”是什么？

    “裸婚”是什么？“裸”是不穿衣服的意思，“婚”是结婚的意思。但是也许要让你们失望了，这个“裸婚”和不穿衣服没有关系。
    “裸婚”是一个网络流行词，是指不买房子、不买车、不办婚礼的一种简单的结婚方式。在中国，结婚一定要有房有车。但是现在房子太贵了，很多年轻人都买不起，所以只能选择裸婚。也有很多年轻人认为，结婚是因为两个人相爱，不应该把有房有车作为结婚的条件。现在中国大多数年轻人都赞同裸婚，但是也有很多父母担心孩子结婚了还没房没车，以后生活会很困难、不幸福。
    除了“裸婚”，网络上还有很多“裸”的流行词。比如没有复习就去考试的，叫“裸考”；还没找到下一个工作就辞职的，叫“裸辞”。
fullText.traditional:
“裸婚”是什麼？

    “裸婚”是什麼？“裸”是不穿衣服的意思，“婚”是結婚的意思。但是也許要讓你們失望了，這個“裸婚”和不穿衣服沒有關係。
    “裸婚”是一個網絡流行詞，是指不買房子、不買車、不辦婚禮的一種簡單的結婚方式。在中國，結婚一定要有房有車。但是現在房子太貴了，很多年輕人都買不起，所以只能選擇裸婚。也有很多年輕人認為，結婚是因為兩個人相愛，不應該把有房有車作為結婚的條件。現在中國大多數年輕人都贊同裸婚，但是也有很多父母擔心孩子結婚了還沒房沒車，以後生活會很困難、不幸福。
    除了“裸婚”，網絡上還有很多“裸”的流行詞。比如沒有復習就去考試的，叫“裸考”；還沒找到下一個工作就辭職的，叫“裸辭”。

raw.synopsis: Naked marriages are becoming more and more popular in China. With the risk of disappointing you, this lesson teaches you all about what this “naked marriage” is.
sentence_translations: “Naked” means not wearing clothes, and “marriage” means matrimony.
But it is possible that you will be disappointed, because “naked marriage” has nothing to do with not wearing clothes.
“Naked marriage” is an online buzzword referring to a simple style of marriage without having an apartment, car or ceremony.
In China, you must have an apartment and a car to get married.
But now apartments are too expensive and a lot of young people cannot buy one, so they have no choice but the naked marriage.
A lot of young people also believe that you get married because you love each other, ..
.. and that you do not need the marriage requirements of having an apartment and a car.
The majority of young Chinese people nowadays endorse naked marriage, ..
.. but a lot of parents worry that their children's lives will be challenging and unhappy if they get married without apartment and car.
Apart from “naked marriage”, there are a lot of other “naked” online buzzwords.
For example, going to an exam without having studied is called “naked exam”.
Resigning from work without having found the next job is called “naked resignation”.
